prompt.original: Use `running-design-reviews`. We have a new web onboarding flow (Figma link). Decision: choose between Flow A and Flow B to ship next sprint. Target user: first-time admin setting up a team. Constraints: must be accessible (WCAG AA), limited eng bandwidth. Run a 45-minute live review and output a Design Review Pack.
